name: YouTube Studio

disclosure.zh: 在「详细信息 → 加工或合成的内容（Altered content）」里如实选择「是」（逼真的 AI 生成/修改内容必须披露）；同时选择「是否为儿童打造」。未通过审计的 API 项目上传会被锁成私密——这里走网页手动发布，不受此限。
disclosure.en: Under Details → "Altered or synthetic content", answer "Yes" when realistic content was made or changed with AI; also set "Made for kids". (Unaudited API uploads are forced private - this web flow is not affected.)

notes: UNVERIFIED selectors: YouTube Studio is a Polymer app; check ids on the live page.
Thumbnail upload needs a verified channel (phone verification); otherwise the cover input is missing and the step is reported not-found.
Tags are appended to the description as #hashtags (the first 3 show above the title).
